text: Implement a matched paired-run executor for the frozen autonomy benchmark
description: Add an async runner boundary that executes every frozen benchmark task once under graph_grounded and once under stateless through an injected sandbox adapter. The runner, not the adapter, stamps task/condition and registered model/tool/token/time budgets; randomize pair order with an injected deterministic ordering function to limit order bias; enforce a hard timeout per run; preserve failures as explicit errors; and return the existing analyzer report. Add tests for complete matched execution, adapter inability to alter identity/budgets, deterministic counterbalancing, timeout/error handling, and invalid incomplete reports. Do not launch live agents or claim a capability result.
reflection: Implemented runAutonomyBenchmark with injected sandbox execution, runner-owned task/condition/model/tool/token/time fields, frozen task copies, validated matched pair ordering, deterministic counterbalancing hook, per-run timeout plus AbortSignal, explicit timeout/adapter errors, and analysis of the preserved run set. Added tests for full matched execution, protected field stamping, counterbalanced ordering, adapter errors, timeout abortion, and invalid ordering. Verification: wrapped-agents/common 88/88 tests passed; TypeScript type-check passed; git diff check passed. No live model run occurred, so no comparative capability result is claimed.

reflections.context: The pre-registered comparison had no mechanism to collect matched runs.
reflections.outcome: Added a sandbox adapter boundary that enforces pair identity, resource budgets, counterbalancing, timeouts, and explicit failure evidence.
reflections.effectiveness: Completes the deterministic experiment infrastructure while avoiding an unsupported capability claim.
reflections.lesson: Experimental conditions and budgets must be stamped by the runner, never trusted to the system under test.
reflections.pattern: Separate frozen tasks, controlled execution, structured telemetry, and outcome analysis.

status.comment: Matched paired-run executor is implemented and internally verified; awaiting user acceptance.

valueRationale: The comparison cannot produce empirical evidence until a runner enforces matched conditions and preserves failed runs.
